extracted.name: Gyeran-ppang
instruction_lines: Mix the butter with 1 egg, the flour, the milk, the sugars, the salt and the baking powder. Mix well. Put it in a silicone mold
Cut the cheese in small squares and put it in the batter, crack open 3 eggs in the middle of the batter
Bake in the oven, i used gas oven, stage 4. I didnt measure the time, but the rule is, if you push a fork in the batter and it comes out clean then its ready
